description: Search Iconify's ~200k professionally designed open-source icons and convert one directly into Rive shapes. Two modes: query-only returns matching icon names; icon+outSpec downloads the SVG and imports it (same output as riv_import_svg). Requires network access to api.iconify.design.

icon.description: Icon to fetch, e.g. 'solar:rocket-bold' (from a previous search)

outSpec.description: Required with icon: output scene-fragment JSON path

name: riv_asset_search
title: Search/fetch professional vector icons (Iconify)
